generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The payment and validity period in technical bid B & D should be same.
The document submitted by bidder in KPP Portal shall not be in corrupted/damaged/protected format.
If price bid is submitted in technical bid, then EMD will be FORFEITED and your offer will be REJECTED.
Bidder shall give undertaking that they have accepted our terms regarding Delivery/Completion, Validity & Payment as per format enclosed.
Bidders shall upload all the Documents in PDF format only.

As per the Government Orders vide FD 417 EXP-12-2024 dated: 09-08-2024, the bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all Other applicable taxes, levies, duties, Cess etc. in the Kppp portal dashboard.
All other terms and conditions as per the NIT.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder or the OEM should have experience in supply and commissioning of regenerative drive system of capacity not less than 1000 KW motor for winder application. Copy of the relevant purchase orders along with performance certificate from the clients shall be enclosed.
The firm must be registered in India with appropriate tax and other administrative authorities. Relevant documents to be enclosed.
Only Manufacture or authorized system integrator are eligible to submit the bid. Relevant documents to be enclosed.

The bidder should have in the last five years period and achieved in at least two financial years, the turnover per annum not less than the Rs.2.50 crore (FY 2020 - 21 , 2021- 22 , 2022 - 23, 2023 - 24 & 2024 - 25 ). The turnover certificate and financial statements certified by Chartered Accountant to be enclosed.
The bidder has to submit the tentative BOQ of the proposed system.
The bidder has to submit the architecture of the proposed system.
The bidder has to submit the undertaking letter from OEM in regard with installation, programming & commissioning of drive.
The successful bidder has to submit the undertaking certificate from OEM in regard with service and spares support for the supplied drive for 10 years after successful commissioning.
GST Registration number and IEC code

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Turn-over and ITR details FY 2020 - 21 , 2021 - 22 , 2022 - 23 , 2023 - 24 & 2024 - 25 and Copies of Profit & Loss statement, Balance Sheets for 2020 - 21 , 2021 - 22 , 2022 - 23 , 2023 - 24 & 2024 - 25 shall be enclosed.
Duly filled technical bid B should be attached in Technical Bid and format can be downloaded from enclosure
Undertaking as per Technical D should be attached and document can be downloaded from enclosures.
Copies of Purchase Order/Completion Certificate/Satisfactory report as a proof for past experience
Complete set of the tender document duly filled and signed by the Tenderer.
Detailed scheme for executing the work along with type and number of equipment, the Tenderer proposes to deploy as per requirements.
Detailed Time Schedule consisting of every activity including preparatory works in sequential manner starting from the date of acceptance of the tender.
Details of work experience in respect of the tender.
The Tenderer should enclose certified copy of Valid PF registration number allocated by the PF authorities.
Tenders of Sick Companies and Companies referred to BIFR will not be considered.
Tenders submitted by a party which is black listed by the Govt. agency will not be considered. Rejection in this regard can be done during course of tender also.
